faqs.q: Can you repair my dryer the same day?
faqs.a: Yes. Same-day dryer repair is our standard service in Houston and nearby cities. Call or book online, tell us what the dryer is doing, and we will schedule a technician for the same day.

faqs.q: Do you repair both gas and electric dryers?
faqs.a: Yes. Our technicians repair gas and electric dryers, including stacked laundry centers. Gas models usually need igniters, flame sensors, coils or thermal fuses; electric models need heating elements, thermostats and fuses.

faqs.q: Is the dryer repair estimate free?
faqs.a: Yes. The technician diagnoses the dryer and gives you a free estimate before any work starts, so you know the price before you decide.

faqs.q: What warranty do dryer repairs have?
faqs.a: Every dryer repair is covered by our 90-day warranty on parts and labor.

faqs.q: Why does my dryer run but not heat?
faqs.a: On an electric dryer the usual causes are a burned heating element, a blown thermal fuse or a failed thermostat. On a gas dryer it is most often the igniter or the gas valve coils. All of these are common, repairable faults.

faqs.q: Why does my dryer take two or three cycles to dry a load?
faqs.a: Long dry times usually mean the dryer cannot exhaust moist air: the vent duct is clogged with lint or crushed behind the machine. A failed moisture sensor can also end cycles early. If the vent is the cause, we clean it — it also removes a real fire hazard.

faqs.q: Is it worth repairing my dryer or should I replace it?
faqs.a: Most dryer failures — belts, rollers, fuses, elements, igniters — are contained, affordable repairs, so fixing is usually worth it. Because the estimate is free and comes first, you can compare the repair price with the cost of a new machine before deciding.
